'''Errata on Projective Telepathy''' compares the '''printed Decipher Cloud City face''' with the '''Decipher Glossary Supplement''' official wording (and notes that Current matches that Supplement). Layout inspired by the LOTR-TCG wiki [https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/PC_Errata/Table PC Errata/Table] and [https://wiki.lotrtcgpc.net/wiki/Errata Errata] hub.

This is a '''fan encyclopedia''' page. It does '''not''' invent game text.

'''Reading the table:''' Original printed "A player" on the OR clause. Errata / Current use "your opponent" / "opponent must choose&hellip;" from the Glossary Supplement. This is Decipher-era errata, not a Players Committee sticker.

== Related PC ruling (not a PT text rewrite) ==

[[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]] has a Card Rulings entry marked '''(Errata)''' in the Advanced Rulebook:

* ''Projective Telepathy cannot cancel this card when it is on table (only if it is 'inserted' or 'revealed').''<ref name="afav">[[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] Card Rulings: Anger, Fear, Aggression (V).</ref>

That ruling constrains how Projective Telepathy interacts with Anger, Fear, Aggression (V); it is '''not''' a rewrite of Projective Telepathy's printed game text.

== Not the same: Projective Telepathy (V) ==

[[Projective Telepathy (V)]] ([[Virtual Set 16]]) is a '''Virtual card''' with different game text (destiny draw / ability-7 battle-destiny lock), not a PC errata sticker on the Decipher interrupt. See that card page for (V) text and sources.
